en.name: Raboot
en.description: Thanks to its superb leg muscles, Raboot can easily heat up the water and produce flames with force more than enough.

abilities.name: Jumping Coach
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in play, flip 3 more coins for the Rabbit Jumping attack used by your Pokémon.

fr.name: Lapyro
fr.description: Son pelage résistant lui permet de supporter la chaleur.

abilities.name: Entraînement au Bond
abilities.effect: Tant que ce Pokémon est en jeu, lancez 3 pièces supplémentaires lorsque l'attaque Bond de Lapin est utilisée par vos Pokémon.

es.name: Raboot
es.description: Su pelaje resistente le permite soportar el calor.

abilities.name: Entrenador de Salto
abilities.effect: Mientras este Pokémon esté en juego, lanza 3 monedas más para el ataque Brinco de tus Pokémon.

it.name: Raboot
it.description: Il suo folto pelo gli permette di resistere facilmente al calore.

abilities.name: Allenatore di Saltelli
abilities.effect: Fintanto che questo Pokémon è in gioco, lancia 3 volte in più quando i tuoi Pokémon usano l'attacco Saltelli da Coniglio.

de.name: Kickerlo
de.description: Dank seines dichten Fells kann es heißes Wasser problemlos ertragen.

abilities.name: Sprungtrainer
abilities.effect: Solange dieses Pokémon im Spiel ist, wirf 3 Münzen mehr, wenn deine Pokémon die Attacke Hasensprung einsetzen.

pt-br.name: Raboot
pt-br.description: Graças ao seu pelo grosso, ele consegue suportar o calor facilmente.

abilities.name: Instrutor Saltitante
abilities.effect: Enquanto este Pokémon estiver em jogo, jogue 3 moedas a mais para o ataque Salto de Coelho usado pelos seus Pokémon.

zh-tw.name: 騰蹴小將
zh-tw.description: 牠那強健的腿部肌肉能讓牠輕鬆地抵抗高溫。

abilities.name: 跳躍指導
abilities.effect: 只要這隻寶可夢在場上，自己的寶可夢使用的招式「兔兒跳」就可以多擲3次硬幣。
